passive.subject: Three AI empires per game; 60 observations per empire milestone.
passive.description: The player issues no commands. Measures autonomous rival development and race completion.

balanced.subject: Player empire; 20 observations per milestone.
balanced.description: Uses a mixed research order and the shared AI for exploration, expansion, military control, economic specialization and beacon commitments.

method: 20 fixed seeds per mode; no resource grants or hidden-fleet queries. All policies issue actions through the shared command API and retain ordinary faction traits. Every completed cycle checks save validity and nonnegative credits, minerals, science and orders. Timing medians include only empires reaching the milestone before the campaign ends; counts are reported alongside them. An even sample uses the mean of its middle pair. Passive timings describe 60 AI empires; other policy timings describe 20 player empires. Outcomes describe these automated policies, not human win rates. Alignment interruptions count transitions from active to inactive; this measure does not distinguish blockade, lost sites and funding shortfalls.
discoveryMethod: Discovery decisions count only the two staged types, The Last Observatory and The Patient Reef, attributed to the faction that made each recorded choice. Completed sites count each world once when its ancient building is first observed after a completed cycle, attributed to its owner then; activeAtFinish counts surviving sites by final owner. Construction can be cancelled or worlds captured, so restoration, completion and final-owner totals may differ. Counts describe these automated policies, not human win rates.

discoveryPolicy.preservation: Preserve an owned or local-Ark site when supporting infrastructure can realistically operate. Wait for prerequisites or reserved funding rather than automatically salvage. Build missing maturation support through ordinary paid construction.
discoveryPolicy.settlement: Scouts leave viable sites intact if an existing Ark can reach them within three known safe jumps, or an owned shipyard is within three charted enterable jumps. Ark route scores subtract 0.7 for a remembered opening discovery and 1.4 for a remembered maturing or ready discovery. Live remote phases and history are never consulted.
discoveryPolicy.valuation: Compare lasting weighted output after construction time against normal paid costs, displaced building output and the final portable reward. Colony role affects useful production and complementary output. Science value falls with remaining research. Planning time estimates own remaining Protocol research, beacon construction, missing colony hosts and alignment, bounded by 45 cycles, the campaign end and public active races. There is no required restoration quota.
discoveryPolicy.constraints: Ordinary resource and order rules apply. Preserve the next beacon budget and alignment payment. Replacement protects beacons, charter supports, maturation supports and the last or strategic shipyard. Known cancelled or captured restoration rights may rebuild at full ordinary prices; salvage never reopens.
